world.title: Israel accused of using kites as pretext to justify escalating Gaza attacks
world.summary: Israel has been accused of using the launching of kites, drones, and balloons as a pretext to justify escalating air attacks on Gaza. On Sunday, Israeli airstrikes resulted in the deaths of three Palestinians, including a four-year-old child. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has threatened further military action in response to these alleged provocations from Palestinian groups.

world.title: Trump administration eyes new H-1B, OPT fees: Why Indian students and tech workers could face fresh US visa shock
world.summary: The U.S. government is contemplating new fees for H-1B petitions and F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT) applications, with specific amounts yet to be disclosed. This potential change could significantly affect Indian students and tech workers, who represent a substantial portion of H-1B visa recipients. The proposals may lead to increased financial burdens for these individuals seeking opportunities in the U.S.

world.title: Iran’s rial currency hits new record low as U.S. prepares to announce more sanctions
world.summary: Iran's rial reached a record low on August 24, 2026, as the U.S. prepared to announce additional sanctions. These new measures are intended to intensify pressure on Iran's economy, which is already struggling due to prior sanctions and a U.S. naval blockade. The rial's value fell to 2.02 million against the dollar, reflecting ongoing economic challenges.

business.title: TCS acquires Porsche’s IT consulting arm MHP Management for €320 million
business.summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) announced the acquisition of MHP Management- und IT-Beratung GmbH, a subsidiary of Porsche, for €320 million ($373.33 million) on August 24. Following this acquisition, Porsche has entered a five-year strategic partnership with MHP and TCS, valued at €1.25 billion. MHP specializes in IT consulting and management services within the automotive sector.

business.title: Gold extends gains as US Treasury buyback fallout keeps buyers in control
business.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) continued its upward trend on Monday, following a significant rally from the previous week after the US Treasury's buyback announcement. As of the latest update, gold is trading at approximately $4,674, reflecting an increase of nearly 1.5% for the day. This marks levels not seen since May 14, indicating strong buyer control in the market.

business.title: India to amend rules within 2 months to address semiconductor, auto component firms’ concerns: Piyush Goyal
business.summary: India plans to amend regulations within two months to address concerns from semiconductor and automotive component manufacturers, according to Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal. During his four-day visit to Japan, Goyal stated that India will not apologize for not opening sectors where foreign goods are supplied at "predatory prices," emphasizing the need for protective measures.

technology.title: Google Pixel 11 Pro is a major downgrade to Pixel 10 Pro in one key area; that's why I didn't buy it
technology.summary: The Google Pixel 11 Pro has been described as a significant downgrade from the Pixel 10 Pro in a crucial aspect. Despite expectations for a straightforward upgrade, the base configuration revealed shortcomings that led to a decision against purchasing the new model. This highlights concerns regarding the advancements in hardware and features between the two iterations of the smartphone.

technology.title: Motorola Razr+ Vs. Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8: Which Compact Foldable Is Better In 2026?
technology.summary: In 2026, consumers are comparing the Motorola Razr+ and Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8, both popular compact foldable smartphones. The Galaxy Z Flip 8 has garnered positive reviews and increased production due to its compact design. Meanwhile, the Razr+ offers a more affordable high-end option. Buyers are weighing features, pricing, and brand reputation to make informed decisions.

technology.title: Meta AI app launched for Mac computers
technology.summary: Meta has launched its AI app for Mac computers in beta, providing system-wide AI assistance, screen reading, and business insights. The app aims to enhance productivity with tailored advice. A public launch is expected soon, and future updates will include on-device WhatsApp scam alerts. This initiative reflects Meta's ongoing commitment to integrating AI into everyday tasks.

sports.title: Chelsea send warning after Mykhailo Mudryk transfer talks collapse
sports.summary: Chelsea have reportedly terminated discussions with Leeds United regarding a transfer for Mykhailo Mudryk, despite the player's desire to join the club. The decision follows the resolution of Mudryk's doping ban earlier this summer, which has cleared him to play. Chelsea's stance indicates they are not willing to proceed with the transfer at this time.

sports.title: Pacer returns to Afghanistan squad for India series
sports.summary: Afghanistan has announced its squad for the upcoming three-match T20I series against India, scheduled from September 13 to 17 at the Arun Jaitley Cricket Stadium in New Delhi. Ibrahim Zadran will serve as the full-time T20I captain for the first time. The series marks a significant opportunity for Zadran to lead the team in international competition.

sports.title: Naveen-ul-Haq returns for India T20Is
sports.summary: Naveen-ul-Haq has been selected to return to international cricket for the upcoming three-match T20I series against India in Delhi. This series marks Ibrahim Zadran's debut as Afghanistan's full-time T20I captain. Naveen's return follows a challenging period, and he aims to contribute significantly to the team as they face India in this important series.

health.title: Ozempic’s new rival? Meet TOFA, a molecule that ramps up fat burning without eating less
health.summary: Scientists at UC Berkeley discovered that TOFA, a new molecule, increased energy expenditure in obese mice without suppressing appetite or reducing food intake. This finding presents a potential alternative to current weight loss drugs like Ozempic, which often cause gastrointestinal side effects. TOFA has not yet been tested in humans, but it may offer a different approach to weight management.

health.title: Aster MIMS Kasaragod Saves Critical Newborn With Advanced
health.summary: Aster MIMS Kasaragod has successfully treated a critically ill newborn suffering from a severe respiratory condition. The medical team utilized advanced respiratory care and specialized neonatal treatment to stabilize the infant, who was born to a couple from Kasaragod. This intervention has provided the newborn with a new lease on life, showcasing the hospital's expertise in neonatal care.

science.title: A tiny “rainbow on a chip” could help supercharge 6G networks
science.summary: Researchers at Loughborough University, in collaboration with an international team, have developed a tiny chip that generates a stable “rainbow” of light. This innovation can produce multiple high-frequency signals simultaneously, potentially enhancing the speed and capacity of future 6G networks. Additionally, its precision may benefit applications in quantum timing, navigation, radar, and space-based technologies.

science.title: Nancy Grace Roman Telescope live updates: NASA readies Roman for launch
science.summary: NASA is preparing the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope for launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket. This telescope aims to advance astronomical discoveries by researching dark energy, searching for exoplanets, and investigating other cosmic phenomena. The mission represents a significant step in understanding the universe, marking the beginning of a new era in space exploration and observation.

science.title: "Space Jellyfish Alert!" A strange glowing phenomenon could appear over Florida on August 25 - Is it dangerous?
science.summary: A SpaceX Starlink launch on August 25 may produce a glowing phenomenon dubbed "space jellyfish" in Florida's pre-dawn sky. This unusual display is caused by the rocket's exhaust interacting with the atmosphere. While visually striking, experts indicate there is no danger to the public. Observers are encouraged to look up to witness this rare occurrence.

entertainment.title: Kriti Sanon shares loved-up picture with rumoured boyfriend Kabir Bahia amid Raksha Bandhan ad controversy
entertainment.summary: Kriti Sanon is facing online criticism following her appearance in a Raksha Bandhan-themed advertisement, which has sparked debate over her festive look and the campaign's concept. Amid this controversy, she shared a series of affectionate pictures with her rumored boyfriend, Kabir Bahia. The juxtaposition of her personal life and professional challenges has drawn significant attention on social media.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, August 25, 2026: Your patience may help you turn steady efforts into tangible results
entertainment.summary: On August 25, 2026, horoscopes suggest that patience will be key in achieving tangible results. Individuals may face multiple responsibilities and should prioritize effectively rather than attempting to manage everything simultaneously. A flexible approach is recommended to balance work and personal commitments. Overall, steady efforts are expected to begin yielding visible outcomes.

entertainment.title: EXCLUSIVE: Trailer of Akshay Kumar-Saif Ali Khan starrer Haiwaan to release digitally on August 25
entertainment.summary: The trailer for the upcoming thriller "Haiwaan," starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, is set to be released digitally on August 25. This follows the teaser launch on August 12 and the release of the song "Mere Hero Hai Woh." There has been significant audience demand for the trailer, as reported by Bollywood Hungama.
